name: Dictated text drops or contradicts a constraint
definition: Verbatim text the plan dictates omits a clause of a constraint stated elsewhere, or contradicts the plan's own criterion.
question_template: Does each dictated text carry every clause of this constraint? Tick each clause.
severity_guidance: Blocking when the text, written as ordered, breaks the constraint; minor when only the wording differs.
known_weakness: Clauses with no distinctive token; only the broad form is visible, the one-clause form is rarely seen.
